title: Staging Charges That Stand in a Contracted Event Value
content:
The room set-up the confirmed guarantee entry is built to settles which contracted extras stand in a Private Event & Banquet Services contracted value.

## The rule

1. Where the room stands set for seated rounds or for a reception, the audio-visual package and the dance floor charge printed against the package both stand in the contracted value, because a floor is laid and dressed for those set-ups.
2. Where the room stands set for theater, for classroom or for boardroom, the audio-visual package printed against the package stands in the contracted value and no dance floor charge is added.
3. Where no confirmed guarantee entry stands to name a room set-up, neither of those two charges stands in the contracted value.

## The figures the two charges take

| Package | Audio-visual package, USD | Dance floor charge, USD | Both together, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 125 | 0 | 125 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 450 | 0 | 450 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 850 | 650 | 1500 |
| Gala Reception Package | 2400 | 1200 | 3600 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 4800 | 1500 | 6300 |

## Set-up by set-up

| The room stands set for | Stands in the contracted value |
| --- | --- |
| Seated rounds | Audio-visual package and dance floor charge |
| Reception | Audio-visual package and dance floor charge |
| Theater | Audio-visual package alone |
| Classroom | Audio-visual package alone |
| Boardroom | Audio-visual package alone |
| No confirmed guarantee entry naming a set-up | Neither charge |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

A booking on the Seated Banquet Package whose confirmed guarantee entry is built to seated rounds carries 850 and 650, that is 1500, in the contracted value. The same booking guaranteed to classroom carries 850 alone. With no confirmed guarantee entry standing on it, it carries neither figure, notwithstanding that the package prints both.
